name: @verseva/design
description: VERSEVA Design: the signature tokens, component contract, Tailwind bridge, and the four-gate enforcement suite (hex, contrast, spacing, type).

scripts.gate: node bin/verseva-gate.mjs --tokens tokens.css --tokens themes/cobalt.css --tokens themes/forest.css --tokens themes/violet.css --tokens themes/slate.css --allow test --exclude swift . studio/src studio/index.html
scripts.studio:build: npm --prefix studio ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix studio run build && npm run -s gate:studio
scripts.gate:studio: node bin/verseva-gate.mjs --tokens tokens.css --tokens themes/cobalt.css --tokens themes/forest.css --tokens themes/violet.css --tokens themes/slate.css --allow GLTFExporter --exclude swift studio/dist
